integrity: The Dirichlet conditional regression and size-biased beta ordering give the all-real-parameter proof. Exact beta-tail calculations were checked independently on 4,156 rational test cases. No independent historical review or independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric Dirichlet distributions and strictly convex twice-differentiable scores are covered; no claim for asymmetric laws, nonconvex scores, test power, or stochastic dominance. The uniform-simplex alpha=1 case is established prior work.
title: A shape-dependent sharp covariance threshold for symmetric Dirichlet samples
